title: Cops Step In When Toxic Man Won’t Leave Girlfriend Alone
description:
On March 22nd, 2023. Police responded to a situation involving a man shoving his pregnant girlfriend to the ground, and also damaging her car, resulting in over $1000 worth of damage.
